title: Rung: quantum mechanics from amplitude and phase

statements.text: Written as $\Psi_t = \sqrt{\rho_t} \, e^{i S_t / \hbar_t}$, the conserved transport keeps its continuity equation and gains a Hamilton-Jacobi equation with a quantum potential from the curvature of the amplitude. For a coherent phase-bearing branch the density and phase equations recombine exactly into the Schrödinger equation, with circulation quantized in units of $h/m$.

sources.quote: the quantum regime is not introduced as a separate ontology.
the density-phase equations recombine exactly into the Schrödinger equation.
